name: @coreguard-global/coreguard-badge
description: CG-BDG/1 — the CoreGuard self-verifying badge engine. Derived artwork that is a pure function of its evidence record: two different records produce two different payloads, the same record always produces the same bytes, and verifyBadge() re-derives the digest from the record, so a forged badge fails verification. Zero runtime dependencies.
author: EslaM-X (CoreGuard Global)
